name.description: The name of the table. Must be 1-50 characters and must only contain hyphens, underscores, periods, letters and numbers.
name.rationale: Table name string in configuration; it is not a key or token and does not by itself authorize reads or writes.

instance_name.description: The name of the Bigtable instance.
instance_name.rationale: References an instance by name; names are not secrets and do not prove caller identity.

split_keys.description: Warning: modifying `split_keys` on an existing table forces Terraform to replace the entire table resource.
split_keys.rationale: Sharding hints for row distribution at creation time; they tune layout/operations and do not list principals allowed on the table.

column_family.description: Defines a column family (repeatable). Structure is documented in nested arguments.
column_family.rationale: Declares schema families for the table; schema blocks alone do not attach IAM members.

family.description: The name of the column family.
family.rationale: Identifier for a column family in schema; not an IAM binding.

type.description: The type of the column family when supported by the provider.
type.rationale: Selects encoding/storage characteristics where applicable; unrelated to authenticating API callers.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Non-secret project id for API ownership; does not embed credentials.

deletion_protection.description: `PROTECTED` prohibits deleting the table, column families, or the instance containing the table via the API. Defaults to `UNPROTECTED` if unset.
deletion_protection.rationale: API-side safeguard against destructive deletes; it does not publish rows publicly—availability/governance oriented rather than client authentication.

change_stream_retention.description: Duration to retain change stream data. Set to 0 to disable. Typically between 1 and 7 days per provider/API limits.
change_stream_retention.rationale: Disabling (`0`) removes change history used for monitoring, recovery, and audit investigations.

automated_backup_policy.description: Automated backup retention and frequency. Omit or set periods/frequency to zero to disable backups.
automated_backup_policy.rationale: Scheduled backups support recovery and incident response for table data.
automated_backup_policy.non-compliant: missing block, or retention_period = "0", or frequency = "0"
